texts.label: text
texts.orig: There are four common growth engines:
texts.text: There are four common growth engines:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You (or your users) create content → People discover your content while searching (e.g. Google, YouTube, TikTok, etc.) → They become users → More users leads to more content
texts.text: You (or your users) create content → People discover your content while searching (e.g. Google, YouTube, TikTok, etc.) → They become users → More users leads to more content

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You run ads online (e.g. FB, AdWords, YouTube), OOH (e.g. billboards, buses), or in-home (e.g. direct mail, TV, podcasts) → Ads drive users → Users generate revenue → Revenue is used to run more ads
texts.text: You run ads online (e.g. FB, AdWords, YouTube), OOH (e.g. billboards, buses), or in-home (e.g. direct mail, TV, podcasts) → Ads drive users → Users generate revenue → Revenue is used to run more ads

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You hire salespeople → Salespeople get customers → Customers drive revenue → Revenue is used to hire more salespeople
texts.text: You hire salespeople → Salespeople get customers → Customers drive revenue → Revenue is used to hire more salespeople

texts.label: text
texts.orig: User signs up → User enjoys product and shares product with other people (either through word of mouth, inviting their friends through your product, sharing content from the app, or incentivized referrals) → Friend signs up and shares it with their friends
